description: Tracks whose file size equals 10323804 bytes are kept along with larger ones.

d.request: Inner join Track to MediaType for tracks with bytes >= 10323804, group by media type name, computing average unit price, average of bytes-per-millisecond, and normalized to the overall average, excluding nulls and returning no rows if overall average is null.
d.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / Milliseconds) as OverallAvg FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804 AND Bytes IS NOT NULL) SELECT mt.Name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) as AvgUnitPrice, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT) / t.Milliseconds) as AvgBytesPerMillisecond, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT) / t.Milliseconds) / oa.OverallAvg as NormalizedBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 AND t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mt.Name HAVING oa.OverallAvg IS NOT NULL

c.request: Joining each track to its media type (dropping tracks with no matching media type) and using 10323804 bytes as the file-size threshold (`Track.Bytes`) to keep only the large files, for each media type name (`MediaType.Name`) give the media type name, the average list price per track (`Track.UnitPrice`), and the average of file size divided by track length (`Track.Bytes` ÷ `Track.Milliseconds`). Also give that last average divided by the plain average of it across all the media types. All averages should ignore missing values and be missing when there are none. Return no rows if the across-media-type average is missing. Leave all values unrounded. Tracks whose file size equals 10323804 bytes are kept along with larger ones.
c.sql:
WITH filtered_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    t.UnitPrice,
    t.Bytes,
    t.Milliseconds,
    m.Name AS MediaTypeName
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
),
media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeName,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DOUBLE) / CAST(Milliseconds AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM filtered_tracks
  GROUP BY MediaTypeName
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DOUBLE) / CAST(Milliseconds AS DOUBLE)) AS overall_avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM filtered_tracks
)
SELECT 
  mts.MediaTypeName,
  mts.avg_unit_price,
  mts.avg_bytes_per_ms,
  mts.avg_bytes_per_ms / oa.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms
FROM media_type_stats mts
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE oa.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL

a.request: Joining each track to its media type (dropping tracks with no matching media type) and keeping only tracks whose file size (`Track.Bytes`) is at least 10323804 bytes, for each media type name (`MediaType.Name`) give the media type name, the average list price per track (`Track.UnitPrice`), and the average of file size divided by track length (`Track.Bytes` ÷ `Track.Milliseconds`). Also give that last average divided by the plain average of it across all the media types. All averages should ignore missing values and be missing when there are none. Return no rows if the across-media-type average is missing. Leave all values unrounded.
a.sql:
WITH filtered_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    t.UnitPrice,
    CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(t.Milliseconds AS DECIMAL) AS bytes_per_millisecond,
    m.Name
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
),
media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    Name,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM filtered_tracks
  GROUP BY Name
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_millisecond) AS overall_avg_bytes_per_millisecond
  FROM media_type_stats
)
SELECT 
  m.Name,
  m.avg_unit_price,
  m.avg_bytes_per_millisecond,
  m.avg_bytes_per_millisecond / o.overall_avg_bytes_per_millisecond
FROM media_type_stats m
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE o.overall_avg_bytes_per_millisecond IS NOT NULL

b.request: For each media type with tracks of at least 10323804 bytes, display the media type name, average unit price, average bytes-to-milliseconds ratio, and this ratio divided by the global average of that metric across all qualifying media types.
b.sql:
WITH qualifying_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.MediaTypeId,
    t.UnitPrice,
    t.Bytes,
    t.Milliseconds
  FROM Track t
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
),
media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    m.MediaTypeId,
    m.Name,
    AVG(qt.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(qt.Bytes * 1.0 / qt.Milliseconds) AS ratio
  FROM qualifying_tracks qt
  JOIN MediaType m ON qt.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(qt.Bytes * 1.0 / qt.Milliseconds) AS global_ratio
  FROM qualifying_tracks qt
)
SELECT 
  mts.Name,
  mts.avg_unit_price,
  mts.ratio,
  mts.ratio / ga.global_ratio AS ratio_vs_global_avg
FROM media_type_stats mts
CROSS JOIN global_avg ga;
b.raw: For each media type with tracks of at least 10323804 bytes, display the media type name, average unit price, average bytes-to-milliseconds ratio, and this ratio divided by the global average of that metric across all qualifying media types.
